chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari from al-Qaddah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The beginning of the prayer is the ablution, its sanctification is the Takbeer, and its legalization is the Tasleem.'
ai.seo_question: What are the ritual beginnings and endings of Salat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi establishes the legal boundaries of prayer, framing Wudu as the preparatory purification, Takbeer as the entry into the sacred state (ihram of prayer), and Tasleem as the exit. In Shia jurisprudence, this triad underscores the ritual precision required for Salat, linking physical purity with spiritual intent. It reflects the Prophetic tradition's emphasis on the structural integrity of worship as a complete, bounded act of devotion.
